name: io.github.ege-usta/rowback
title: Rowback
description: Postgres gateway for AI agents: blocks destructive SQL, holds risky writes, undoes applied ones.

environmentVariables.name: ROWBACK_AGENT_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Connection string for the low-privilege role the agent's SQL runs as.

environmentVariables.name: ROWBACK_ADMIN_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Connection string for the control role that owns the rowback schema (checkpoints, undo, ledger).

environmentVariables.name: ROWBACK_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to rowback.yaml (protected tables, limits). Without it, ./rowback.yaml or defaults.
